classes.name: punching/slapping other person
fine: A person's hand moves rapidly toward the other person's upper body and retracts.
coarse: One participant extends an arm toward the partner while the partner's upper body reacts.
global: Two people interact as one person punches or slaps the other person.

classes.name: kicking other person
fine: A foot lifts and extends toward the other person's lower body before returning.
coarse: One participant balances on one leg and swings the other leg toward the partner.
global: Two people interact as one person kicks the other person.

classes.name: pushing other person
fine: Both hands extend toward the other person's torso and move forward together.
coarse: One participant straightens the arms toward the partner while the partner's torso shifts away.
global: Two people interact as one person pushes the other person.

classes.name: pat on back of other person
fine: A hand reaches behind the other person's shoulder and makes short repeated movements.
coarse: One participant stands close to the partner and bends an arm toward the partner's back.
global: Two people interact as one person pats the other person on the back.

classes.name: point finger at the other person
fine: A hand extends toward the other person and remains directed toward that person.
coarse: One participant holds an arm out toward the partner with limited whole-body movement.
global: Two people interact as one person points a finger at the other person.

classes.name: hugging other person
fine: The hands and forearms move around the other person's upper torso.
coarse: Both participants approach closely and bring their arms around each other.
global: Two people hug each other.

classes.name: giving something to other person
fine: One hand extends toward the partner's receiving hand and then withdraws.
coarse: One participant reaches forward while the other participant brings an arm toward the offered hand.
global: One person gives something to another person.

classes.name: touch other person's pocket
fine: A hand reaches toward the side of the other person's hip and briefly stays there.
coarse: One participant bends an arm toward the partner's waist while standing nearby.
global: One person touches another person's pocket.

classes.name: handshaking
fine: The participants extend hands toward each other and make small coordinated vertical movements.
coarse: Both participants face each other with one forearm extended into the space between them.
global: Two people shake hands.

classes.name: walking towards each other
fine: Alternating steps move the participants' feet toward the space between them.
coarse: Both participants walk so that the distance between their torsos decreases.
global: Two people walk towards each other.

classes.name: walking apart from each other
fine: Alternating steps move the participants' feet away from the space between them.
coarse: Both participants walk so that the distance between their torsos increases.
global: Two people walk apart from each other.

classes.name: hit other person with something
fine: A hand follows a pronounced swing toward the other person's body.
coarse: One participant swings an arm toward the partner while the partner's torso moves in response.
global: One person hits another person with an object.

classes.name: wield knife towards other person
fine: A raised hand makes a thrusting or swinging motion toward the other person's upper body.
coarse: One participant repeatedly extends a bent arm toward the partner from a nearby stance.
global: One person wields a knife towards another person.

classes.name: knock over other person
fine: The participants' shoulder regions move together and one person's torso lowers or tilts.
coarse: One participant moves the whole body toward the partner, causing a large change in the partner's posture.
global: One person knocks over another person by body contact.

classes.name: grab other person's stuff
fine: A hand reaches toward the other person's hand and quickly pulls back toward its own torso.
coarse: One participant reaches across the space between the bodies and retracts an arm in a pulling motion.
global: One person grabs something from another person.

classes.name: shoot at other person with a gun
fine: A hand is held extended toward the other person's upper body with a brief forward-directed motion.
coarse: One participant faces the partner and holds one or both arms in a forward aiming posture.
global: One person shoots at another person with a gun.

classes.name: step on foot
fine: A foot lifts slightly and moves down toward the other person's foot.
coarse: One participant shifts weight and places a foot near the partner's foot while both stand close.
global: One person steps on another person's foot.

classes.name: high-five
fine: Both participants raise a hand and move their palms toward each other before separating.
coarse: The participants lift their forearms toward a shared point above shoulder height.
global: Two people give each other a high-five.

classes.name: cheers and drink
fine: The participants bring raised hands toward each other and then move their hands toward their mouths.
coarse: Both participants first extend bent arms toward the center and then flex their elbows toward their faces.
global: Two people make a toast and drink.

classes.name: carry something with other person
fine: Both participants hold their hands at a sustained height while taking coordinated steps.
coarse: The participants maintain a shared arm posture and move together with relatively stable separation.
global: Two people carry an object together.

classes.name: take a photo of other person
fine: One participant brings both hands together in front of the face or chest and holds them toward the partner.
coarse: One participant raises the forearms into a steady framing posture while the other participant remains in view.
global: One person takes a photo of another person.

classes.name: follow other person
fine: Both participants take repeated steps in a similar direction with one behind the other.
coarse: One participant moves after the partner while maintaining a following position.
global: One person follows another person.

classes.name: whisper in other person's ear
fine: One participant moves the head toward the side of the partner's head and may raise a hand near the mouth.
coarse: One participant leans the upper body close to the partner's head while the partner stays nearby.
global: One person whispers in another person's ear.

classes.name: exchange things with other person
fine: Both participants extend and retract their hands in reciprocal passing movements.
coarse: The participants coordinate forward arm movements so that each both offers and receives.
global: Two people exchange things with each other.

classes.name: support somebody with hand
fine: One participant keeps a hand near the other person's arm or torso as the partner moves.
coarse: The participants remain close, with one maintaining an extended supporting arm beside the partner.
global: One person supports another person with a hand.

classes.name: finger-guessing game
fine: The participants move their hands rhythmically toward the shared space and finish with brief held hand poses.
coarse: Both participants face each other and coordinate repeated forearm and hand movements.
global: Two people play rock-paper-scissors.
